name: b2c_retail_form
answers: We sell hand-poured candles directly to consumers online.
Mostly women aged 25 to 45 in the UK who like home decor.
They want gifts that feel personal. Cheap mass-market candles are our competition.
notes: A B2C company is never asked about buyer roles or departments. Step 2 answers B2C, so the industry, company size and buyer cards are hidden and must not be required.
